purpose: Diagnose actual unit-start Gu windows before selecting an algorithm modification.
holdout_dither: iid, shared seeds across curves and histories
evaluation: all eight cells and both methods; unit coefficients, frozen training endpoint and continued-online sine; every checkpoint uses the same sine record; exact integer-code errors and approximate FFT
rejection_policy: retain failures and overload counts; no parameter or seed replacement
limitations: synthetic cubic families with new parameters, inputs, seeds and histories; no chip claim, global convergence claim or new algorithm comparison
